tools.name: fundraiseup_list_campaigns
tools.description: List fundraising campaigns (name, status, type, currency, designations, frequencies). Filter by parent or subaccount id, or by designation. Fundraise Up API: GET /v1/campaigns.

tools.name: fundraiseup_get_campaign
tools.description: Get one campaign with its settings, content blocks, media, designations and frequencies. Fundraise Up API: GET /v1/campaigns/{id}.

tools.name: fundraiseup_list_donations
tools.description: List one-time and recurring-installment donations, newest first: amount, currency, status, campaign, designation, supporter, payment times. Fundraise Up API: GET /v1/donations.

tools.name: fundraiseup_get_donation
tools.description: Get one donation with its amounts, fees, status, campaign, designation, supporter, payment and recurring-plan links. Fundraise Up API: GET /v1/donations/{id}.

tools.name: fundraiseup_list_recurring_plans
tools.description: List recurring donation plans: amount, frequency, status, next installment date, cancellation details, supporter and campaign. Fundraise Up API: GET /v1/recurring_plans.

tools.name: fundraiseup_get_recurring_plan
tools.description: Get one recurring plan with its amount, frequency, status, cancellation reason and supporter. Fundraise Up API: GET /v1/recurring_plans/{id}.

tools.name: fundraiseup_list_supporters
tools.description: List donor (supporter) records with contact details and supporter-level fields, as shown in the Fundraise Up Supporters view. Fundraise Up API: GET /v1/supporters.

tools.name: fundraiseup_get_supporter
tools.description: Get one supporter (donor) record with contact details and supporter-level fields. Fundraise Up API: GET /v1/supporters/{id}.

tools.name: fundraiseup_list_events
tools.description: List account events (audit log): changes to donations, recurring plans and supporters, with the type and the affected object. Use it to see what changed and when. Fundraise Up API: GET /v1/events.

tools.name: fundraiseup_list_fundraisers
tools.description: List peer-to-peer fundraiser records (the individual supporter pages that raise money for a campaign). Fundraise Up API: GET /v1/fundraisers.

tools.name: fundraiseup_get_fundraiser
tools.description: Get one fundraiser record. Fundraise Up API: GET /v1/fundraisers/{id}.

tools.name: fundraiseup_list_designations
tools.description: List designations (the funds or purposes donors choose). Filter by campaign id. Fundraise Up API: GET /v1/designations.

tools.name: fundraiseup_get_designation
tools.description: Get one designation with its name, code and status. Fundraise Up API: GET /v1/designations/{id}.

tools.name: fundraiseup_list_subaccounts
tools.description: List subaccounts under the account of the API key. Use their ids to filter campaigns. Fundraise Up API: GET /v1/subaccounts.

tools.name: fundraiseup_get_subaccount
tools.description: Get one subaccount record. Fundraise Up API: GET /v1/subaccounts/{id}.
